svg.title: Ngong Lane, 10.40 on a Tuesday
svg.desc: A city street with a four-storey building cut open to show four floors inside, two towers, a half-built site behind a hoarding, a tailor's stall under an awning, and eight people working.

g.text: Jengo House is cut open on the left. The stall on the corner has been there thirty-one years.
